parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: The filename must include the file extension.

parameters.name: fileUrl
parameters.description:
Choose either fileUrl or fileUrlObject.

- fileUrl: The URL of a single document. The document can have up to 1,000 pages and be up to 100 MB in size.

- fileUrlObject: The local file to upload when you call the API. The document can have up to 1,000 pages and be up to 100 MB in size.

> Supported formats:
>
> - bmp, jpe, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, webp, heic

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The unique ID of the extraction template, which specifies the content to extract from the document. To obtain the ID, log on to the template management page and configure a template.

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the extraction template, which specifies the content to extract from the document. To obtain the ID, log on to the template management page and configure a template.
